about: The card batch's findings: the design's own rulings and cases (docs/card-design.md, section 13 overriding), cited by `// batch card: <id>` above a STRUCTURAL assertion — one that checks a fold count, a marker, an order, a snapshot or a guard and has no printed clause to quote. An assertion that checks printed text cites the page of the record the test drives instead (`// batch card premise: <aon doc id> "<the page's words>"`). An id starting with '#' has an EMPTY record part: these rulings are about every card, not one record, so scripts/test-flip-audit.mjs accepts one only because its entry declares `scope: 'design'` and a `rule` naming the docs/card-design.md section it stands on; an undeclared '#…' id is refused. `removed` lists the exact titles of describe blocks a design rule deleted (card step 22's legacy paths) — the only way the audit lets a describe removal through.
